name: What types of wheelchair ramps are available for home installation?

mainEntity.name: What types of wheelchair ramps are available for home installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are several common types of wheelchair ramps for homes. Portable ramps are temporary and good for occasional use. Modular ramps are pre-fabricated sections that can be configured to fit various spaces and are often used for longer-term needs. Custom-built ramps, typically made from wood or concrete, are permanently installed and designed to blend with your home's aesthetics. Each type offers different advantages in terms of cost, permanence, and customization, making it important to consider your specific needs and property layout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common types include portable, modular, and custom-built ramps made from wood or concrete. Each has different benefits depending on your needs and home structure.
